g.text: Storage Model: Series Identity, Compressed Blocks, Small Relational Metadata
The raw tier isn't a table -- it's compressed blocks addressed by series_id. Monitors and dashboards are the only classic relational entities here.
resolves a tag filter to a posting list
payload: t0+v0 raw, then per point: delta-of-delta ts + XOR(value)
Time-series storage is columnar and compressed; only the small metadata tables are classic relational schema.
